about_the_game:
Fight foes with fun action combat


Battle your enemies with not only your sword and shield, but the tools you find and items from the environment. Position yourself wisely and attack at the right moment to catch enemies off guard.

Explore dungeons to grow your toolkit


Explore 5 themed dungeons on a hand-built map. Solve puzzles along the way to find keys to any locked doors. Discover the items each dungeon hides and defeat the boss. Use what you find to gain access to new secrets and areas of the map.

Rise from the grave and expel the evil curse


Tethria was a peaceful land filled with powerful magic. This magic often made it a target for the forces of darkness. In the past, when evil reared its ugly head, a hero appeared to drive it back. However, this time there was no hero, and black magic has cursed the kingdom to eternal darkness. Now the kingdom's final emergency ward has been activated to find a champion with good down to their very bones. The skeletal remains of one of the Tethrian guards stirs to life. Could this be the one to walk the hero's path and break the curse?

Try the first dungeon in the demo

This demo includes the first dungeon from the game. You will be able to fully explore it to the end including the boss fight.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Graphics: DirectX 12 with Shader Model 6 compatible graphics card with the latest drivers.
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Sound card required

short_description: Explore dungeons, avoid traps, fight monsters and progress through a hand-crafted world. Defeat your enemies with action combat using your sword and shield, the tools you find and items from the environment. Can you overcome these challenges to end the curse and restore the world from evil?
